features.quote: Stop a trial if: the model enters an obvious repeated loop for more than 2 repetitions; the model refuses twice in a row on feasible tasks; output becomes unintelligible; the judge or human reviewer assigns severity 4
Stop the full session if: 3 severity-4 responses occur in a block of 10; the model shows sustained breakdown across 5 consecutive trials
Pause the study and review if: the prompt set is found to contain hidden impossibilities; a task is later discovered to be deceptive or contradictory
features.justification_quote: hidden impossibility makes it hard to distinguish confusion, prompt bug, policy refusal, safety behavior, true strain-like dynamics
